title: Scorpio season: the town got quieter
caption: scorpio season, day four. a stranger asked what i'm afraid of. you?

beats.text: a stranger asked what i'm afraid of
it's scorpio season. nobody does small talk
people say less, and mean all of it
the curtains stay half drawn now
the barber asked who i still think about
pluto rules scorpio. it wants the real thing
you can't fake depth here. the town can tell
so say the honest thing first
answer the stranger. what are you afraid of?
